name: sonora-backend
description: API per l'e-commerce di strumenti musicali

scripts.db:setup: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -q -1 -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/schema.sql -f db/seed.sql
scripts.db:migrate: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && for f in db/migrations/*.sql; do psql "$DATABASE_URL" -q -1 -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$f" || exit 1; done
